effort: none: a headless Junie 26.9.7 run applies --effort through EffortLevel.forModelOrDefault, which silently falls back to the model's default for a level the model lacks (the 26.9.7 build's code; see this folder's README)
login: Junie's own sign-in: the JetBrains account you sign in to in an interactive `junie` (kept under ~/.junie), or JUNIE_API_KEY set in your own environment; the row never reads, sets or stores a key
